decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the SK6812 Mini-E selection and 3.3V supply for the addressable-LED interface.
A same-message MODIFY already records the selected SK6812 Mini-E part and 3.3V supply for the addressable LED chain used by this interface.
A complete same-message MODIFY already adds the confirmed 3.3V SK6812 Mini-E LEDs to the loads powered by the standalone 3.3V rail.
A complete same-message MODIFY already adds the confirmed 3.3V SK6812 Mini-E LEDs to the DCDC1 rail's normal-operation loads.
The LED part and supply-voltage decision does not change USB data routing, enumeration, or standalone flashing behavior.
The selected LED part and its supply voltage do not affect USB-C connector selection or sourceability.
The existing requirement already states that AXP2101 powers all system loads in normal operation; confirming one load's 3.3V voltage does not change that power-path state.
The current 5V-rail load list already excludes the LEDs, so confirming that the selected LEDs use 3.3V requires no state change.
The LED part and voltage decision does not alter I2C pull-ups, bus speed, cabling, or series-resistor policy.
The LED selection and supply voltage do not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The LED's 3.3V operating supply does not change battery protection thresholds, controller choice, or protection components.
The LED part and voltage decision does not resolve or alter the battery connector family, part number, pin functions, or ambiguous pin order.
